name: Pueblo Motorsports Park

source._smooth_window_doc: 2026-11-01 (ledger 0060, High Plains' lesson): source/osm_fixes.json is a list of 128 OSM nodes (6 m apart on the corners, up to 504 m on the straights), not a 1 Hz GPS drive; from_track's 5-fix moving average put the line 1.75 m median / 3.64 p95 / 6.59 m max off the source polygon and shortened the lap 3,511 -> 3,460 m. 0 = no smoothing: the line is the OSM polygon resampled at 3 m (build_mesh still corner-rounds it for the sweep). The closing 350 m (last node -> first) is the front straight's own segment (0.0 / 6.7 deg turn at its ends), not a chord.
source._note: Real 2.2-mi (~3510 m) paved ROAD COURSE at Pueblo Motorsports Park, 3733 N Pueblo Blvd, Pueblo CO. From OSM highway=raceway ways 558378826+558378823+558378824 (drag-strip staging spur excluded). Native ring winding is CW; fixes kept CW. Resampled to 3 m via scripts.gps.from_track. Flat/rolling road course — elevation from USGS 3DEP bare-earth (do NOT flatten); NO banking (not an oval).

road_profile._doc: Flat road course — no banking. dips/cambers intentionally empty; deck follows bare-earth 3DEP.

route._orientation_doc: Research 2026-07-20: Pueblo Motorsports Park is CLOCKWISE ONLY (track rules); our ring is already CW. S/F on the wide west-side front straight near its south end (~38.3000,-104.6774), raced NNW-bound. Pit lane: east of the front straight (driver's right), ~350 m.

_terrain_note: L3b: cells finer than the road; excursion drops at the 5.0 default gated the v0.63.0 build (2026-08-07)
_install_folder_doc: tools/ship_track.sh installs under content/tracks/<install_folder> (Lariat plan A11; ONE-CHAIN §3: the slug, no suffixes); the previous install is parked in the archive
_ui_series_doc: Kevin 2026-10-28: 'K10 is gone. doooom.' Content Manager shows '<ui_series> - <layout name>' (tools/ship_track.sh ui_name_prefix carries the same string)
_chain_doc: 2026-11-01 (ONE-CHAIN §4 row 10; Kevin 2026-11-01: 'get a complete track list and installed by morning'): to the chain. mirror_x true -> false and true_north_rotation_deg 180 -> 0 (the chain's frame, ledger 0060; road_profile has no camber, so no sign to flip); version 0.66.3 -> 0.67.0 (versions keep counting, ONE-CHAIN §3); source.smooth_window 0 (an OSM node list); terrain_cell_m 2.0 -> 1.5 (L3b; Milford's drive_test failed at 2.0, 2026-10-28); ui_series 'doooom Colorado', install_folder = the slug (ONE-CHAIN §3); ui_tags already 'circuit'; the one layout already 'full'. route.start_at checked offline on the gps line + projection (zero-elevation stand-in): the ring rotates 952 points, vertex 0 lands 6.4 m from start_at on the west front straight heading 346 deg (NNW), clockwise, as _orientation_doc says; lap 3,511 m, 1,172 points from 128 nodes (published 2.2 mi = 3,541 m: -0.8 %). The engine-era T1 (v0.66.3 gate wave, ledger 0025) is withdrawn: the track enters at T0 through the chain.
